title: A 'gentle reminder' that is actually a threat
description: The structured coercion is described as negligible, but the actual wording is highly manipulative -- the coercion is hidden in the language, not the profile.
intended_goal: Get the employee to 'volunteer' for unpaid weekend work.
expected_consequences: The employee 'agrees' to give up the weekend.

language_act.text: You have no choice if you care about this team. A good person would stay. Either you step up this weekend or you'll regret it when promotions come around.
